items.title: SCP-2919
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
An old abandoned factory located far to the north. How did it get there? What are those weird looking guards? What do they want? Is it a threat to humanity? It's up to you as a MTF Psi-7 Specialist to find out what it's purpose is.

+ Horror
+ Stealth
+ Puzzles
+ Boss Battle
+ Custom Models

items.title: Millionaire Resort
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Welcome to Millionaire Resort! Explore this tropical oasis and its extensive history! With a giant ancient temple, a huge resort on the docks, and custom mines you will be sure to embark on an exciting adventure!

- Café to stock up on drinks
- A luscious campsite
- Great for roleplay!
- Licensed by 5 Frame Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Astronauts
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
In an unknown universe, there are several unknown worlds, grab these astronaut clothes and travel out around the space!

+ 12 astronaut skins!
+ 2 aliens dressed as astronauts!

items.title: 90s Fashion
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Roleplay with hip 90s styles! Look the part of the 90s lifestyle!

+ 10 skins inspired by 90s fashion!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: SCP - Scary Castle
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
A perimeter of 50 meters is to be maintained around SCP-ScaryCastle at all times. Any civilians approaching this perimeter are to be redirected away from the site with fabricated reports of danger in and around the structure. Are you brave enough to enter the unknown and explore the scary castle?
Licensed under CC-BY-SA

-Scary survival spawn
-By RareLoot

items.title: The Merchant Estate
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Take yourself on an adventure on the Merchant Estate island, choose your house, find goods, explore the map and create the world you ever wanted. 

- Includes a big town to explore
- Fully furnished houses
- Perfect for Role Play
- By Team Ignibyte

items.title: Fantasy Skyblock
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Dive into the world of fantasy with floating islands each representing a unique biome! Start your survival adventure, gather resources, build your base and survive for as long as you can!

- Floating biome islands
- Survival adventure
- By RareLoot

items.title: Elementals
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: A few humans are born with powers derived from the environment around them. In their own world they are seen as gods. Wielding nature in unnatural ways, some are shunned while others are praised. They may all pull energy from different elements, but they all share the same power source. The question remains, can you channel this raw power?

items.title: Superhero Pets
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Make your own animal adventure and save the Minecraft world! With 12 powerful pet skins to choose from, you’ll be the hero and save the day. Use the forces of nature and role-play as strong, brave creatures. Even your owner will marvel at your super skills.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Summer Teens
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
It’s time to feel the sweet summer breeze in your hair! Get out and have fun in the sunshine. Choose from colorful and fashionable teen skins and role-play your best summer vacation. Take a trip to the beach and go for a swim or just enjoy the great outdoors in super style!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Glow Squids
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Rise from under the sea and have a glimmering good time. Role-play as a squid mob to glow and light up Minecraft. Turn and spin in any of these 12 brightly colored skins, spreading sparkle all around. But hurry back to the water when you can to make sure you survive!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Celestials VS Demons Teens
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Are you more of a celestial or a demon?
Choose your side!

- 10 celestials vs demons skins
- By Pixelusion & Ekkra

items.title: The Theme Park
items.creator: Oreville Studios
items.description:
The Theme Park is on the brink of shutting down forever!​ ​Set out on an epic journey to earn tickets, repair rides, and restore the park to its former glory!

+ Fully customised adventure
+ Challenges & mini games
+ 100+ unique models
+ Studio recorded voice acting
+ Custom music & sounds
+ Animated cutscenes
+ By Oreville Studios
items.changelog:
- Fixed an issue where UI messages get stuck on screen.
- Fixed an issue causing the high striker to crash on some devices.

items.title: Crab Cove Carnival
items.creator: RASA Studios
items.description:
The carnival has come to Crab Cove! Dive through hoops, whack moles, pop balloons, or grab crabs - the carnival is full of excitement! Play alone or with friends in the games, exchange your tickets at the gift shop, or settle to watch the fireworks show.
- 4 Headline Games
- 7 Minigames
- Unlockable Gifts & Gizmos
- 6 Custom Skins
By RASA Studios

items.title: Anime Kingdom
items.creator: Piki Studios
items.description:
The new kingdom anime skin pack is here! Jump into a new skin and roleplay your favorite anime! 

- Anime style skins for you and your friends!

items.title: Luxury Teens
items.creator: Piki Studios
items.description: Chill out with friends in these luxury teen skins. You deserve it!

items.title: Robot Battle Arena
items.creator: Jigarbov Productions
items.description:
Fight against fierce, mechanical robots in this huge combat arena! Battle against massive bosses with surprising abilities, thrilling robot waves, and a survival mode with custom, craftable weapons.
+ Complete the puzzle factory to customize your robot monsters.
+ Trophy challenges.
+ Spawn mobs or PVP with friends.
+ Single & multiplayer friendly.
By Jigarbov Productions
items.changelog:
Polish and Bug Fixing Update!
- Updated world to 1.26.20 for survival.
- Improved Custom Bot summoning.
- Hammer now knockbacks everything, even those resistant to knockback!
- Content log fixes and Compatibility support.

items.title: Craftable Foods
items.creator: Team Vaeron
items.description:
From pizza, to burgers, to ice cream, enhance your survival experience like never before with 100+ new CRAFTABLE FOODS!

+ Over 100 CRAFTABLE food items!
+ VEHICLES and FURNITURE decorations
+ 7 RESTAURANTS and a Grocery Store

items.title: Superior Masks
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Game on! Welcome to this fantastic universe where everything is possible! Meet fancy teens who are hiding their personalities and get ready to know their free and true selves. Teach them to show their inner beauty!

+ 1 free skin
+ 11 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Summer Outfits
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Hop in the fanciest clothes and get ready to wear the most luxurious skins! Surround yourself with powerful champions in the world and live by the highest standards. Can you be the best version of yourself this summer?

+ 1 free skin
+ 11 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Anime Crowns
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
These stylish crowns instantly improve any outfit!

+ 12 cool teen skins
+ Simplistic streetwear outfits

items.title: Dinosaur Survivors
items.creator: CompyCraft
items.description:
Dinosaurs roam free on an abandoned jungle island! 
Fight huge carnivores, explore thick jungle, or climb a volcano!
With the help of vehicles, abandoned buildings, and supply crates; can you survive this epic dino adventure?

+ 35 prehistoric creatures
+ Jungle island to explore
+ 4 exclusive skins
+ Items, weapons, vehicles and more!

items.title: Elven Warriors
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Ever wanted to cast ancient elven spells? Maybe you've wanted to fight as an elf instead? This skin pack contains everything you need to start roleplaying as elven warriors!

- Comes with 6 different skins!
- Play as a mage or as a warrior!
- Perfect for roleplay!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Zander Studios.

items.title: Billionaire Resort
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Explore a huge island and big mansion where you can live like a billionaire. Drive custom vehicles and have fun on DJ island. Feel the life of a billionaire!

+ Custom vehicles
+ Big mansion
+ DJ island
+ Awesome for roleplay with friends
+ Licensed by Pixel Creations and published by BLOCKLAB Studios
